findings.decompiled: log Initialized(address collateralToken=cd[0], address borrowerNote=cd[32], address lenderNote=pool)
findings.source: IMaplePoolManagerInitializer.sol:6 event Initialized(address owner_, address asset_, address pool_); MaplePoolManagerInitializer.sol:91 emit Initialized(poolDelegate_, asset_, address(pool))
findings.issue: The event's field names come from an unrelated contract with the same topic (collateralToken / borrowerNote / lenderNote for poolDelegate / asset / pool), which misleads.
findings.rule: As in c00113: take field names from the database only when the entry is unambiguous for the topic (or prefer the build's ABI when present).

notes: Unoptimised MaplePoolManagerInitializer (15 functions: storage getters, decodeArguments, encodeArguments 0xb628fee9 and the fallback initializer); all reviewed in full, no loops. The fallback decodes its arguments from calldata offset 0 (it is delegatecalled with raw arguments), sets the lock (stor0 = 1), checks the pool delegate and asset through mapleGlobals (via caller, the factory), validates initialSupply / migrationAdmin, creates the MaplePool from its embedded creation code (code.data[5747 len 23530] plus constructor arguments) and the PoolDelegateCover (code.data[29277 len 2349]), stores both and emits Initialized; all correct. The bytecode's size (31.6 KB) is mostly the embedded creation code, which the text correctly shows as code.data slices.
summary: A clean, faithful, loop-free text; the only oddity is the event's misleading field names from the signature database.
